name_zh: 胡斯/捷克/宗教/改革/康斯坦茨/火刑/民族/布拉格/查理大学
description_zh: 扬·胡斯（1373-1415），捷克宗教改革家，宗教改革先驱，采取了革命性宗教改革和启蒙运动，对捷克民族觉醒产生深远影响。
description_en: Jan Hus (1373-1415), Czech religious reformer, religious reform pioneer, implemented revolutionary religious reforms and enlightenment movement, profoundly influenced Czech national awakening.
reason_zh: 胡斯是宗教改革先驱，其宗教改革和启蒙运动对捷克民族觉醒产生深远影响。
reason_en: Hus was religious reform pioneer, his religious reforms and enlightenment movement profoundly influenced Czech national awakening.
cross_cultural_impact: Religious reform implementation; Czech national awakening; Protestant movement;
spiritual_tradition: Catholic reform / Czech patriotism / Religious freedom
